comment: Recorded from the operator's webcam through the Gesture module (Download session, JSONL) while the operator held Closed_Fist, Thumb_Down, Thumb_Up, and Open_Palm three times each, with a neutral hand between holds and no aircraft selected. Landmarks are stripped from every recognizer frame; category, rawCategory, score, and handedness per hand and every header, policy, status, and intent entry are verbatim. The policy entries are the live output of the rule in force when it was recorded: minScore 0.80 for every pair and a reset on any single frame below it.
